meta.what: Net gain per euro of sales for every seller other than Russia and Ukraine: other taxes on production plus profit above a normal return, as a share of output, by industry group (round 13 audit: one valuation rule for every seller)
meta.formula: (D29X39 + B2A3N - SELF x D1/SAL - r x N11NA) / P1; B2A3N = B2A3G - P51C where only gross surplus is published
meta.normal_return_basis: real, after company tax, on capital at current replacement cost (STAN N11NA), plus the country risk premium (country_risk_r14.json)
meta.use: multiply a gross sale by the group share and by value_kept.json's 'genuinely extra' factor; economies outside STAN take oecd_median
